scientific_limitations: Only the stationary two-coordinate harmonic tracer-bath diffusion with independent thermal noises, positive reset rate, and instantaneous probe-only Poisson resets is treated.
The frozen-bath tracer mixture formula and exact second-order moments already appear in or follow from prior work and are not newly claimed.
Weak convergence does not establish uniform far-tail asymptotics or finite-sample error bounds.
Publication priority is provisional pending independent literature assessment.
title: Frozen-bath convergence and a Gaussian observation-window crossover for resetting tracers
